global_bias_bound_reason: Physical population, selection and luminosity-evolution alternatives are not uniquely identified. Conditional matrix propagation cannot create an empirical bound on omitted mean-model bias.
combination_rule: Do not add all listed quantities in quadrature. Some are alternate models, some are shared covariance modes, and some remain unquantified. Preserve joint nuisance covariance, cross-object response and already-included release components.

channels.assumption: A phase-independent empirical SALT colour coordinate suffices to transport colour-dependent luminosity across the selected population.
channels.uncertainty: Signed per-object responses to added extinction are supplied; their perturbation amplitudes are not inferred dust posteriors.
channels.needed: Selection-aware population comparison, independent colour dimensions and optical/NIR/spectral transfer tests.

channels.assumption: Historical and current SNANA option 99 implement the same extinction curve.
channels.uncertainty: Exact-minus-approximate monochromatic response, independently verified; not itself a distance correction.
channels.needed: Paired simulation, fitting, selection and BBC response with the same calibration/training to isolate full effect.

channels.assumption: The adopted extinction family remains an attenuating physical screen throughout the simulated RV support.
channels.uncertainty: Frequency of fixed-wavelength negative extinction in written simulations and constructed broadband consequence recorded. An actual-SNANA fixed-sample floor stress changes 4 of 12 low-RV mocks, with maximum pre-BBC standardized shift 0.000655 mag; 12 matched controls are unchanged. This does not bound the population/selection/BBC effect or establish a true correction.
channels.needed: Refit physically admissible dust-law/population alternatives, then rerun selection and BBC with shared seeds and simulation-noise controls.

channels.assumption: Released mass/redshift-conditioned intrinsic colour, RV and reddening PDFs describe the relevant parent and selected populations.
channels.uncertainty: Probability-grid normalizations, tails, mass interpolation and parameter response are conditional on those grids; they are not observed population frequencies.
channels.needed: Held-out colour/luminosity/scatter/host tests, flexible distributions and prior sensitivity with valid selection normalization.

channels.assumption: Foreground map normalization, law and spatial variation are adequately represented in training and fitting.
channels.uncertainty: Shared released MW modes and conditional per-object extinction responses retained. Applying another .86 scale to already-scaled HEAD values would double-correct this diagnostic.
channels.needed: Joint map/calibration/training uncertainty and sky-dependent validation, without counting the same released mode twice.

channels.assumption: Passband/zeropoint variations and retrained surfaces span the relevant shared calibration uncertainty.
channels.uncertainty: Covariance factors have arbitrary eigenvector signs; source perturbation realizations cannot be uniquely reconstructed from covariance alone. CALSPEC overlaps the calibration/SALT group; removing this double count resolves Dovekie's component-sum discrepancy numerically. The original release has an unassigned positive remainder.
channels.needed: Signed paired output vectors and original remainder provenance, consistent retraining and gauge alignment.

channels.assumption: Two trained surfaces and one colour law span luminosity-relevant spectral/time variation.
channels.uncertainty: Additional phase-dependent colour structure is a documented alternative; this audit does not convert another survey's residual trend into a DES correction.
channels.needed: Matched retraining and survey-transfer injections using additional spectral/time modes.

channels.assumption: A coherent local Hessian and SALT residual covariance accurately represent the measurement likelihood.
channels.uncertainty: Keep amplitude/shape/colour cross-covariances. Local positivity does not prove Gaussian tails, coverage or an adequate mean SED.
channels.needed: Flux-level coverage with model mismatch, clipping, repeated epochs and tails.

channels.assumption: Matrix filenames and all individual components can be interpreted as interchangeable additive covariances.
channels.uncertainty: Original systematic covariance versus Dovekie packed total precision are handled separately. Whitened signed eigenspectra and reconstruction tolerances are preserved; no silent PSD repair.
channels.needed: Higher-precision component provenance for indefiniteness and the original release's unassigned remainder; do not double-count grouped CALSPEC; use verified full released likelihood for current inference.

channels.assumption: Simulator-conditioned bias maps transport to the real selected population over fitted colour, stretch, mass and redshift.
channels.uncertainty: Released alternative systematic modes do not establish completeness of the model family or a universal correction matrix.
channels.needed: Generated/selected/refitted truth tracking, mismatched-generator recovery, support/importance-weight diagnostics, classification and survey transfer.

channels.assumption: Residual host/age luminosity, intrinsic colour and reddening can be separated from the available summary observables.
channels.uncertainty: Exact latent reparameterizations preserve colour and magnitude. Removing an explicit mass step does not undo mass-dependent simulated bias correction.
channels.needed: Additional observables or disclosed restrictive population assumptions; propagate host-estimator uncertainty and avoid applying an old age slope twice.

channels.assumption: Admitted luminosity evolution cannot mimic the inferred distance-redshift shape.
channels.uncertainty: Local cosmology/dust/design collinearities are recorded. No finite global physical bias bound follows from SN magnitudes alone under arbitrary luminosity drift.
channels.needed: Restricted and physically tested evolution models or additional independent information; report conditional inference and prior dependence.
